title: Charred American Noodle Bake
description: A comforting, slightly charred noodle dish with a mix of flavors and textures, perfect for a cozy evening.
instructions: Peel and chop the sweet potatoes into 1-inch cubes. Place on a baking sheet, toss with 2 tbsp of butter, salt, and pepper. Roast in the oven for 20 minutes, or until tender.
Chop the carrots into 1-inch pieces. Toss with 2 tbsp of butter, salt, and pepper. Roast in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until tender.
Cook the American noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked noodles, roasted sweet potatoes, and carrots.
In a separate bowl, mix together the bake cheese blend and 1 tbsp of butter.
Pour the cheese mixture over the noodle mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
